  `doctor_id` int NOT NULL,
  `appointment_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `consultation_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `destination_location_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `destination_location` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Doctor / Treatment Room',
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `requested_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `resolved_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved_by_role` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved_by_user_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolution_note` text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  KEY `idx_supply_request_groups_status` (`status`,`requested_at`),
  KEY `idx_supply_request_groups_doctor` (`doctor_id`,`status`,`requested_at`),
  KEY `idx_supply_request_groups_appointment` (`appointment_id`,`status`,`requested_at`),
  KEY `idx_supply_request_groups_destination` (`destination_location_id`),
  KEY `fk_supply_request_groups_consultation` (`consultation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_supply_request_groups_appointment` FOREIGN KEY (`appointment_id`) REFERENCES `appointments` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_supply_request_groups_consultation` FOREIGN KEY (`consultation_id`) REFERENCES `consultations` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_supply_request_groups_destination` FOREIGN KEY (`destination_location_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_locations` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_supply_request_groups_doctor` FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`) REFERENCES `doctors` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `supply_requests` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `request_group_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `doctor_id` int NOT NULL,
  `inventory_id` int NOT NULL,
  `qty_requested` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `destination_location` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Doctor / Treatment Room',
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT 'pending',
  `requested_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `resolved_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved_by_admin_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolution_note` text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `destination_location_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `uniq_supply_request_group_item` (`request_group_id`,`inventory_id`),
  KEY `doctor_id` (`doctor_id`),
  KEY `inventory_id` (`inventory_id`),
  KEY `idx_supply_request_destination_location` (`destination_location_id`),
  KEY `idx_supply_request_pending_dedupe` (`doctor_id`,`inventory_id`,`destination_location_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_supply_request_group` (`request_group_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_supply_request_destination_location` FOREIGN KEY (`destination_location_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_locations` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_supply_request_group` FOREIGN KEY (`request_group_id`) REFERENCES `supply_request_groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `supply_requests_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`) REFERENCES `doctors` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `supply_requests_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`inventory_id`) REFERENCES `inventory` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
